sentences.en: The correct use of prepositions will be the death of me.
sentences.zh: 正确使用介词可能会要了我的命。

sentences.en: You can omit the preposition in this phrase.
sentences.zh: 在这个短语中可以省略介词。

sentences.en: However, the preposition+relative pronoun (which) part becomes a relative adverb (where).
sentences.zh: 然而，介词+关系代词（which）部分变成了关系副词（where）。
